build.procedure: projects/chirality-app-v4/app/packaging/unsigned/README.md (debug, --no-sign, custom-protocol) from a git archive export; existing C1 bundle re-identified under candidate-identity-v2 without rebuilding
build.signing: none: --no-sign; only the linker's incidental ad-hoc signature, not Developer ID signing

environment.CARGO_HOME: default user Cargo home (prepared offline cache)
environment.npm: npm install --offline --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts from the existing user npm cache

phases.interval_basis: started_at includes offline npm preparation; finished_at is the completed Tauri bundle. Whole-second UTC markers span 68 seconds.
phases.marker_intervals: 7 seconds from npm preparation start to Tauri command start; 61 seconds from Tauri command start to bundle completion; 68 seconds overall. Marker precision is one second.
phases.cargo_reported_elapsed: 56.38 seconds for the Cargo dev-profile phase, as printed by Cargo; this excludes npm preparation, Tauri/frontend work outside Cargo, and final bundling. It is not the complete build duration.

limits: Identifies the exact bundle bytes, structure, modes, ownership and allowlisted extended attributes read at identification; reproducible rebuilding is not claimed.
Unpackaged development build (route native_development): no signing, notarisation, package record or packaged witness.

File times and location are outside the identity: examine this copy in a controlled location without relying on timestamps, launch-registration caches or timestamp-based resource selection; record the actual examination environment separately.
ACLs, non-zero file flags, set-id bits, extended attributes outside the allowlist, absolute or escaping links and special files are refused, not omitted.
Descriptor-relative no-follow reads with two equal passes detect ordinary change during reading; they do not establish custody against a concurrent hostile writer.
The Codex supplier is not part of the bundle; each examination record binds its own supplier pin, distribution identity and configuration.
No examination is opened, no App is launched and no candidate qualification, replacement or acceptance follows from this record.
App-data absence is historical at identification, limited to the three declared identifier-selected locations; it is not a freshness promise after launch or a census of external state.
